analytics.subtitle: Pipeline, attribution, scoring and CRM health
analytics.helpContactScore: Score from 0 to 100 combining 3 signals: Activity (opens, clicks, replies in last 30 days), Fit (how well the contact matches your ICP), and Status (pipeline position).
analytics.helpActivity: Points based on email opens, clicks, replies, and how recent the last interaction was (last 30 days).
analytics.helpFit: How well this contact matches your Ideal Customer Profile: sector, company size, job title.
analytics.helpChurn: Risk of losing this contact (0-100). Based on inactivity, stagnant deals, unanswered emails, and missing profile data.
analytics.helpForecast: Revenue forecast adjusted by win probability at each stage. A $10k deal at 50% probability = $5k weighted.
analytics.helpSalesCycle: Average number of days from first contact to closing a deal.
analytics.renewalsEmpty: No renewals detected. Contacts need a renewal_date or close_date in your CRM.
analytics.noTrendsData: Not enough historical data. Trends will appear after a few weeks of activity.
analytics.segmentSelectToView: Click a segment card to view contacts
analytics.engagementNoData: No engagement data yet. Activity will appear once emails are sent and tracked.
analytics.tabDescPipeline: Where are your contacts in the sales funnel? Track progression from first contact to close.
analytics.tabDescAttribution: Which campaigns drive the most conversions? See ROI by campaign and channel.
analytics.tabDescScoring: Unified score (0-100) combining activity, ICP fit, and pipeline status. Focus on the hottest contacts first.
analytics.tabDescTrends: How are your KPIs evolving week over week? Spot patterns in open rates, replies and more.
analytics.tabDescChannels: Email vs LinkedIn vs multi-channel — which channel performs best for your audience?
analytics.tabDescForecast: Revenue projections based on your pipeline. Weighted forecast and top deals to watch.
analytics.tabDescSegments: Your contacts grouped by behavior: champions, active, new, at-risk, dormant.
analytics.tabDescEngagement: How engaged are your contacts? Scored from 0-100 based on recent activity.
analytics.tabDescRenewals: Upcoming contract renewals and overdue ones. Never miss a renewal again.
analytics.tabDescHealth: Data quality audit: duplicates, missing fields, invalid emails. Clean your CRM in one click.
